inputs.label: Ocarina of Time dump
inputs.help: A dump of your own Ocarina of Time cartridge or GameCube disc in a supported version (N64 PAL 1.0/1.1, NTSC-U and NTSC-J 1.0 to 1.2, or the GameCube OoT and Master Quest discs).

steps.text: Open OoT VR from Library > Unknown Sources. Select Select ROM, then your dump in Download. Wait a few minutes for the extraction and keep the headset on. Afterwards you can delete the dump.

notes: The guide shows a .z64 example only; .n64, .v64 and .iso for GameCube discs are assumptions. Accepted SHA-1s are in port/docs/supportedHashes.json in the repository; not copied into sha1 yet. The game builds oot.o2r from the dump. Releases sometimes carry .mp4 clips, which the asset pattern avoids.
